import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')
print(df['Category'].unique())
print(df['Program'].unique())
# Compute total spend
total_spend = df['Amount (INR)'].sum()
print("Total spend:", total_spend)

# Program-Category spend
group = df.groupby(['Program','Category'])['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
group['pct_of_total'] = group['Amount (INR)'] / total_spend * 100
group = group.sort_values(['Program','Category'])
print(group)

# Also overall program spend
prog = df.groupby('Program')['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
prog['pct'] = prog['Amount (INR)']/ total_spend *100
print(prog)

import pandas as pd
file_path = '/data/asha_ngo_finances_FY25-26.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Transactions')
total = df['Amount (INR)'].sum()
group = df.groupby(['Program','Category'])['Amount (INR)'].sum().reset_index()
group['pct'] = group['Amount (INR)']/total*100
group['pct_one_decimal'] = group['pct'].round(1)
print(total)
print(group[['Program','Category','Amount (INR)','pct','pct_one_decimal']])
# Program category only
program_mask = group['Category']=='Program'
program_total = group.loc[program_mask,'Amount (INR)'].sum()
program_pct = program_total/total*100
print("Program category total:", program_total, program_pct)
